title: Claude Can Hide a Watermark in Your Text #Shorts
description:
Claude can embed an invisible watermark directly in generated text. The signal can survive copy and paste, but detecting it does not prove Claude authored every sentence.

Watch the full breakdown: https://youtu.be/FmE_wpcLzBg

Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773-how-claude-marks-ai-generated-content
